A *whence* value of 0 measures from the beginning of the file, 1 uses the current file position, and 2 uses the end of the file as the reference point.  *whence* can be omitted and defaults to 0, using the beginning of the file as the reference point. ::

   >>> f.read(1)
   b'5'
   >>> f.seek(-3, 2)  # Go to the 3rd byte before the end
   13
   >>> f.read(1)
   b'd'
